errata.found: The diplomatic layer omitted one clause of its sole carrier: 'ἐμμί· τεθνάκην δ’ ὀλίγω ʼπιδεύην' between 'χλωροτέρα δὲ ποίας' and 'φαίνομαι' — the death-adjacency clause. The layer joined χλωροτέρα directly to φαίνομαι, producing a line boundary (old 31.15) present in no witness, and collapsing two distinct verbs (ἐμμί, predicative; φαίνομαι, seeming) into one.
errata.consequence: The seat's header asserted EXTRACTED VERBATIM and no editorial normalization applied; both claims were false for 75 of the carrier's 80 words. Any analysis scoring a death/collapse channel against this layer returned a false zero — including, on 2026-08-23, a nine-channel profile in-session that reported M9=0 for Sappho 31 and attributed the absence to the operator rather than to the extraction.
